packages.name: Escobar_Full_Film_Project_Recovery.zip
packages.purpose: Profile, processed narration, raw-take timing/ASR, common runtime/tools/tests, stills, fonts/license, geo data and QC metadata. Not a self-contained archive of research videos/raw WAVs; recovery links and extraction paths are in the project README. Upload receipt delivery.json is intentionally external to avoid a self-referential archive hash.

packages.name: Escobar_Final_Encoded_Review_Evidence.zip
packages.purpose: Actual final encoded sample grids and sheets, final audit, exact-prefix proof, audio identity, fallible ASR and tests. Review completion covers the documented samples, not every24fps frame, manual listening, user approval or rights. Earlier corrected_half_sheet files retained in encoded_review refer to the predecessor encode; final_changed files refer to the final encode.

packages.name: Escobar_Review_Provenance.zip
packages.purpose: Predecessor evidence used in exact-index image-hash reuse. ACTUALLY INSPECTED: all initial26 half sheets; then all7 corrected half sheets,15pre-final join sheets and9pre-final motion sheets; source-native quote-tail sheet. Other initially generated join/motion sheets were NOT inspected and are not counted as review. Final changed27half/19join samples are in the final evidence package.
